Package com.framed.interop.mapping

Class ObservationMapping

java.lang.Object
com.framed.interop.mapping.ObservationMapping
public final class ObservationMapping extends Object
Bidirectional mapping between FRAMED channels and CodedConcepts, loaded from a JSON file.

Keys are channel identifiers in one of two forms, resolved most-specific first:

  • "<className>.<deviceID>.<channelID>" — device-specific
  • "<className>.<channelID>" — applies to any device

The reverse index (code -> channel) is used for inbound HL7: a received observation's code is mapped back to the FRAMED channel coordinates it should be published under.
